translation:
[Fall Semester 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) Session 1 Special Lecture: "Overview of Thesis Writing"

Posted: 2026-09-02

We are announcing the first special lecture, "Overview of Thesis Writing," of the Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) [졸업프로젝트(전기공학설계프로젝트)] for the Fall Semester of the 2026 academic year.

The lecture slides are also posted; anyone who needs them may download and use them.

This special lecture is intended for students currently taking the Graduation Project.

As the topic concerns thesis writing, there will be no restriction on auditing for undergraduate students who plan to take the Graduation Project in future.

In particular, third- and fourth-year undergraduates who will soon need to write a graduation thesis are encouraged to attend.

• Lecture title: Overview of Thesis Writing [논문 작성의 개요]
• Lecturer: a professor of the department (name given in the original notice)
• Date and time: Friday, 11 September, 18:30
• Location: Building 301, Room 102 [301동 102호]

※ Students enrolled in the course will receive an F if they are absent (or late) for two class sessions, so please be sure to attend. (One absence: grade lowered by one step, e.g. A+ → A0; two absences: F.)
※ Attendance will be checked at 18:30.
※ Every year some students fail to earn credit because of attendance problems, so please take care.

* Due to the nature of the lecture, entry from 19:00 may be restricted. Those who wish to audit are asked to enter before 19:00.
As some students are attending as part of the regular course, there may be additional instructions for auditors.

Attachment (1 file): lecture slides in PowerPoint format (.pptx, 3 MB), dated 20260911. The content of this attachment was not read and is not included in this translation.

For enquiries, please contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
